"""Recover exact F2 transport, then execute only previously unstarted model phases."""
import os,sys,json,subprocess,time,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1];META=ROOT/'benchmarks/rtx_trajectory_cost_v4'
os.environ.update(PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',GODEBUG='http2client=0',HTTPS_PROXY='http://127.0.0.1:17891',HTTP_PROXY='http://127.0.0.1:17891')
sys.path.insert(0,str(META))
import FAN_AMENDMENT_ARCHIVE_RECOVERY as recovery
from prepare import save,now,sha
import freeze,guards,study,verify_joint,closeout,paper_evidence,package
operator=recovery.operator
EXPECTED_F2='f9b88dcdc5541297a32faa0437b2bad2b93ffafc'
OUT=ROOT/'work/fan-amendment/transport-recovery1'
TRANSPORT=['dial tcp','connectex','wsarecv','HTTP 5','HTTP 429','HTTP/2','connection reset','TLS handshake','i/o timeout','unexpected EOF','connection was forcibly closed']

def retrieve_exact_F2():
    assert freeze.git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==EXPECTED_F2
    assert not (META/'F2_REMOTE_RECEIPT.json').exists()
    assert not (ROOT/'work/A-live').exists() and not (ROOT/'work/B-formal').exists()
    for checkpoint in ['F0','FAN_AMENDMENT','F2']:guards.check_manifest(checkpoint+'_MANIFEST.json')
    for attempt in range(1,4):
        partial=ROOT/'work/frozen-checkpoints/F2'
        if partial.exists():
            preserved=ROOT/'work/fan-archive-attempts'/('F2-remote-attempt'+str(attempt))
            for p in [partial,preserved]:p.resolve().relative_to(ROOT.resolve())
            assert not preserved.exists();preserved.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);partial.rename(preserved)
        try:
            receipt=freeze.receipt('F2');assert receipt['commit']==EXPECTED_F2
            assert receipt['full_retrieval_verified']
            break
        except subprocess.CalledProcessError as error:
            # Preserve any failed attempt; only unchanged transport is retryable.
            if attempt==3:raise
            assert freeze.git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==EXPECTED_F2
            save(OUT/('receipt-transport-failure'+str(attempt)+'.json'),{'utc':now(),'error':repr(error),'exact_content_commit':EXPECTED_F2,'model_processes_started':0})
            time.sleep(3)
    old=ROOT/'work/fan-amendment/recovery1/records.json'
    log=ROOT/'work/FAN_RECOVERY_STDOUT.log'
    save(META/'FAN_TRANSPORT_RECOVERY.json',{'utc':now(),'status':'EXACT_F2_REMOTE_RETRIEVAL_PASS','content_commit':EXPECTED_F2,'scope':'Transport-only retry of unchanged F2; no predictor/archive regeneration or model retry. Only previously unstarted native phases follow.','original_failure_record':json.loads(old.read_text(encoding='utf-8')),'original_failure_log_utf8':log.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='strict'),'source_utf8':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),'source_sha256':sha(Path(__file__)),'local_proxy_used_for_transport':True,'frozen_numerical_source_changes':0,'model_reruns':0})

def formal_B():
    assert json.loads((META/'A_trajectory/REPORT.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['execution_complete']
    study.B_formal(type('Args',(),{'authorization':'EXECUTE_FROZEN','reviewed_sha':operator.AUTH['original_F0']})())

def run():
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    record={'status':'STARTED','started_utc':now(),'scope':'Exact F2 transport recovery, then unstarted A live/B under explicit fan amendment.','original_pre_live_conditions_reused_unchanged':228,'new_native_conditions_planned':228,'formal_model_retries':0,'stages':[]}
    save(OUT/'records.json',record)
    try:
        for name,fn in [('retrieve-exact-F2',retrieve_exact_F2),('A-native-live',operator.live),('B-matched-cost',formal_B),('independent-verification',lambda:verify_joint.all_reached(ROOT)),('closeout-and-paper',lambda:(closeout.reached(),paper_evidence.main(),operator.final_scope())),('complete-A-capsules',lambda:package.make('complete','A')),('complete-B-capsules',lambda:package.make('complete','B')),('complete-index',closeout.index)]:
            row={'stage':name,'status':'STARTED','started_utc':now()};record['stages'].append(row);save(OUT/'records.json',record);print('START',name,flush=True)
            fn();row.update(status='PASS',ended_utc=now());save(OUT/'records.json',record);print('PASS',name,flush=True)
        record['status']='COMPLETE'
    except Exception as error:record.update(status='STOPPED_PRESERVED_FOR_REVIEW',error=repr(error));raise
    finally:record['ended_utc']=now();save(OUT/'records.json',record)
if __name__=='__main__':run()
